messages.text:
"Rough conceping stage for Ratledune

a story of a boy by the name of W.D Comic Srifken Dreemurr (or just Srif as he's usually called) who got his first and second name from his father - Sans - and despite the nice little 17 year old boy exterior, the interior of himself has a very deep rooted rooted hatred from his self stemed by demon face syndrome that only effected himself and regrets for his childish doings that keeps trying to heal by masking it with kindness and keeping his words to himself. 
The Dreemurrs have moved back into their old town, that will be refered to as \"Oppidan\" which is a bit chilly so everyone wears thermanals (and Asgore was there, and he was still a police officer, and Toriel being Toriel slightly disliked Asgore). there, was his old friends and one of them - being Michale (or Mich for short) - being a Tiger monster wearing a black ushanka and a black jacket who acts all tough at first as he doesn't recognise Srif as Srif accidentally sprayed water on Mich as they washed hands in a bathroom but as Mich pinned Srif down to hurt him but as Mich looked closer, he finaly recognised Srif and softened as he recognised Srif.
One of his other friends, being Chris (or Christtoph Holiday) Being in the Holiday family full of does and dears, who recognised Srif ammedeatly at first sight and got actually joyous, and Srif being Srif, he gave Chris a hug. Srif will open the \"Novella\" (which is another world but just really small), and it will be opened by Srif from his demon syndrome with the diaulog will say \"it's you...\" \"you are in the mirror\" and with hatred unfurling into his head and his face distoring in the mirror and Srif will smash the mirror and fall in the Novella, it's kinda like a Dark world in Deltarune but looks more bright and more like the omori world
"
